title: The staff list has a read-only "Technician" column directly left of Billable
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three new staff members for this test, enrolled at the test location: staff member A with Time Clock on and Technician on, staff member B with Time Clock on and Technician off, and staff member C with Time Clock off, each with Billable set to Yes.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps: 1. Find staff member A, staff member B and staff member C in the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A column headed "Technician" sits directly left of the Billable column.
  • Staff member A's row shows "Yes" in green.
  • Staff member B's row shows "No" in red.
  • Staff member C's row shows "No" in red.
  • The Technician values use the same coloured Yes/No look as the Billable column next to it (Billable shows "Yes" for all three).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists), story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • S4-R1: “The staff list (Settings, Staff) gains a read-only "Technician" column directly left of Billable, on the Active and Deactivated tabs. Each row shows "Yes" (green) when the person is active, their Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise "No" (red), in the same style as the Billable column. A deactivated person always shows "No", whatever their toggles.”
  • Terminology: “Technician → in this PRD, a staff member whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on. It is not the role named "Technician": a person on any role except the built-in Office User and Time Clock User roles can be one.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "1 Staff list", picture "Notice and Technician column" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p1-02-after-notice-and-technician-column.png

The design's own words:

  • “Notice, verbatim: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."”
  • “No close button: it disappears for everyone on the "New" pill's end date.”
  • “Technician column, read-only and sortable, just left of Billable: Yes when the person's Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise No. A deactivated person always shows No. It changes only through the staff window (page 2).”
  • “"New" pill at the top right of the Technician header. It goes away at 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this; the exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”
